Maza Meter

Kitna paisa, kitna maza.

Pick the kind of trip, your budget and month. The Maza Meter shows where and when your money buys the most fun, after seasonal hotel and flight prices. It rewards a great place in its right month at a fair price, not a cheap place.

Costs are 2026 per-person estimates in ₹ (return travel, stay, food, local transport, visa). Hotel and flight levels were checked against live Booking.com and Google Flights fares. Check live prices before booking.
